answer: Require each identity to lock a small copper deposit that thaws only as slowly as a glacier: funds stay frozen for weeks and are released in small tranches, so an operator minting thousands of clones must lock capital for every one at once, while a gale of quick churn cannot free it early. Honest single identities barely notice the delay, but a sybil farmer pays the time value on the whole fleet and cannot recycle one deposit across many names. Limit: newcomers with little capital need a low tier or sponsored path, or cost becomes a barrier to entry.
